# 📄 Document AI & OCR Directory

![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.0-blue) ![tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/tools-27-green) ![open%20source](https://img.shields.io/badge/open%20source-17-brightgreen) ![categories](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-4-purple) [![CI](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/document-ai-ocr-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/document-ai-ocr-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

> A curated, machine-readable directory of **Document AI & OCR** tools — OCR engines, document parsers (PDF → Markdown/JSON), layout/table extraction, and managed Document AI APIs.

This repo catalogs public projects/products with links and key attributes (open-source, license), and ships a small CLI to search/filter/export the registry. No third-party code is vendored here.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install -e .              # stdlib-only; no runtime deps
doc-dir list                  # list all
doc-dir list --open-source    # only OSS
doc-dir search tables         # search name/org/note/tags
doc-dir export --format csv > document-ai.csv
doc-dir generate              # regenerate this README
```

|------|-----|---------|-------|

## Choosing one (rules of thumb)

- **Plain OCR (self-host):** Tesseract, PaddleOCR, EasyOCR, docTR.
- **PDF → clean markdown for RAG:** Docling, Marker, MinerU, Unstructured.
- **Tables:** Camelot / pdfplumber (text PDFs), Table Transformer (images).
- **Math / scientific:** Nougat (OSS) or Mathpix (API).
- **Don't want to run models:** Textract, Azure DI, Google Document AI, LlamaParse, Reducto.

> Note licenses: some strong open parsers are copyleft (MinerU AGPL-3.0, Marker GPL-3.0 with a commercial option) — check before commercial use.
